title: Self-Hosted Agentic AI & n8n Automation Engine
description: Enterprise-grade self-hosted n8n and AI agent runtime built on Azure Container Apps with Postgres storage, Redis queueing, and webhook routing.
longDescription: Designed and deployed a zero-downtime, event-driven automation platform using n8n Cloud and Azure Container Apps. Leveraged custom agent tool calling and AI workflows to automate ticket routing, automated PDF processing, and GitHub PR reviews.
highlights: Reduced routine operational overhead by over 10 hours per week across development teams.
Engineered resilient error recovery and webhook queue retries using Redis and PostgreSQL.
Integrated OpenAI/Claude API functions directly into custom n8n workflow nodes.

title: Cloud Native Microservices & HRM Platform
description: High-throughput Human Resource Management microservice backend engineered with Spring Boot, Spring Security JWT, Docker, and PostgreSQL.
longDescription: Developed a modular backend architecture featuring decoupled User and HR services, granular role-based access control (RBAC), JWT authentication, dynamic report generation, and automated database migrations.
highlights: Achieved sub-90 second deployment pipelines with zero-downtime rolling container updates.
Implemented strict security policies and audit logging for sensitive payroll and employee records.
Engineered automated PDF pay-stub and report export services.

title: High-Performance Portfolio & Content Engine
description: Zero-cost personal engineering portfolio and blog platform built with Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, MDX, and Supabase.
longDescription: Built a clean architectural portfolio adhering to modern UX principles, dark theme tokens, interactive project filters, MDX learning journal, custom Figure zoom components, and serverless contact handling.
highlights: Attained 98+ Lighthouse performance, accessibility, and SEO scores.
Designed serverless contact API route with Zod validation, honeypot protection, and n8n webhook triggers.
Integrated zero-cost database persistence with Supabase Postgres and public Storage.

title: Distributed Web Crawler & Log Pipeline
description: Asynchronous high-volume data ingestion pipeline built in Python with AsyncIO, ClickHouse, and Docker swarm orchestration.
longDescription: Engineered an open-source concurrent log collector capable of streaming, parsing, and storing real-time network traffic and server diagnostics.
highlights: Processed over 50,000 requests per minute with minimal memory footprint.
Built custom Grafana dashboards and Prometheus metrics exporters.
